text_en: You shall not spread a false report. You shall not join hands with the wicked to act as a malicious witness.
text_cn: 不可传播谣言；不可与恶人携手作假见证。

text_en: You shall not follow a majority in wrongdoing; when you bear witness in a lawsuit, you shall not side with the majority so as to pervert justice;
text_cn: 不可随从多数以附和恶事；在争讼的事上，不可随从多数说歪曲正义的话。

text_en: nor shall you be partial to the poor in a lawsuit.
text_cn: 在争讼的事上，也不可偏袒弱小。

text_en: When you come upon your enemy’s ox or donkey going astray, you shall bring it back.
text_cn: 假使你遇见你仇人的牛或驴迷了路，应给他领回去。

text_en: When you see the donkey of one who hates you lying under its burden and you would hold back from setting it free, you must help to set it free.
text_cn: 假使你遇见你仇人的驴跌卧在重载下，不可弃而不顾，应帮助驴主卸下重载。

text_en: You shall not pervert the justice due to your poor in their lawsuits.
text_cn: 你对穷人的诉讼，不可歪曲他的正义。

text_en: Keep far from a false charge, and do not kill the innocent and those in the right, for I will not acquit the guilty.
text_cn: 作伪的案件，你应戒避。不可杀无辜和正义的人，因为我决不以恶人为义人。

text_en: You shall take no bribe, for a bribe blinds the officials, and subverts the cause of those who are in the right.
text_cn: 不可受贿赂，因为贿赂能使明眼人眼瞎，能颠倒正义者的言语。

text_en: You shall not oppress a resident alien; you know the heart of an alien, for you were aliens in the land of Egypt.
text_cn: 不可压迫外侨，因为你们在埃及国也作过外侨，明了在外作客的心情。

text_en: For six years you shall sow your land and gather in its yield;
text_cn: 你应种地六年之久，收获地的出产；

text_en: but the seventh year you shall let it rest and lie fallow, so that the poor of your people may eat; and what they leave the wild animals may eat. You shall do the same with your vineyard, and with your olive orchard.
text_cn: 但第七年，你应让地休息，把出产留给你百姓中的穷人吃；他们吃剩的，给野兽吃。对葡萄和橄榄园，也应这样行。

text_en: Six days you shall do your work, but on the seventh day you shall rest, so that your ox and your donkey may have relief, and your homeborn slave and the resident alien may be refreshed.
text_cn: 六天内你应工作，第七天要停工，使你的牛驴休息，使你婢女的儿子和外侨都获得喘息。

text_en: Be attentive to all that I have said to you. Do not invoke the names of other gods; do not let them be heard on your lips.
text_cn: 凡我吩咐你们的，都应遵守。你们不可提及外神的名字，决不可让人由你口中听到。

text_en: Three times in the year you shall hold a festival for me.
text_cn: 每年三次应为我举行庆节。

text_en: You shall observe the festival of unleavened bread; as I commanded you, you shall eat unleavened bread for seven days at the appointed time in the month of Abib, for in it you came out of Egypt. No one shall appear before me empty-handed.
text_cn: 应遵守无酵节：照我所命的，在阿彼布月所定的日期，七天之久吃无酵饼，因为你在这个月离开了埃及。谁也不可空着手到我台前来。

text_en: You shall observe the festival of harvest, of the first fruits of your labor, of what you sow in the field. You shall observe the festival of ingathering at the end of the year, when you gather in from the field the fruit of your labor.
text_cn: 又应遵守收成节，即你在田地播种劳力之后，献初熟之果的庆节。还应遵守收藏节，即在年尾，由田地中收敛你劳力所得的庆节。

text_en: Three times in the year all your males shall appear before the Lord God .
text_cn: 你所有的男子一年三次应到上主台前来。

text_en: You shall not offer the blood of my sacrifice with anything leavened, or let the fat of my festival remain until the morning.
text_cn: 不可同酵面一起祭献牺牲的血；不可把我节日的牺牲脂肪留到早晨。

text_en: The choicest of the first fruits of your ground you shall bring into the house of the Lord your God. You shall not boil a kid in its mother’s milk.
text_cn: 你田中最上等的初熟之果，应献到上主你天主的殿中；不可煮山羊羔在其母奶之中。

text_en: I am going to send an angel in front of you, to guard you on the way and to bring you to the place that I have prepared.
text_cn: 看我在你面前派遣我的使者，为在路上保护你，领你到我所准备的地方。

text_en: Be attentive to him and listen to his voice; do not rebel against him, for he will not pardon your transgression; for my name is in him.
text_cn: 在他面前应谨慎，听他的话，不可违背他，不然他决不赦免你们的过犯，因为在他身上有我的名号。

text_en: But if you listen attentively to his voice and do all that I say, then I will be an enemy to your enemies and a foe to your foes.
text_cn: 如果你听从他的话，作我所吩咐的一切，我要以你的仇人为仇，以你的敌人为敌。

text_en: When my angel goes in front of you, and brings you to the Amorites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Canaanites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites, and I blot them out,
text_cn: 我的使者将走在你前，领你到阿摩黎人、赫特人、培黎齐人、客纳罕人、希威人和耶步斯人那里；我要消灭他们。

text_en: you shall not bow down to their gods, or worship them, or follow their practices, but you shall utterly demolish them and break their pillars in pieces.
text_cn: 他们的神像，你不可朝拜，也不可事奉，也不可作那些人所作的；反之，应彻底破坏那些神像，打碎他们的神柱。

text_en: You shall worship the Lord your God, and I will bless your bread and your water; and I will take sickness away from among you.
text_cn: 你们事奉上主你们的天主，他必祝福你们的饼和水，使疾病远离你们。

text_en: No one shall miscarry or be barren in your land; I will fulfill the number of your days.
text_cn: 在你境内没有流产和不育的妇女；我要满你一生的寿数。

text_en: I will send my terror in front of you, and will throw into confusion all the people against whom you shall come, and I will make all your enemies turn their backs to you.
text_cn: 我要在你前显示我的威严；凡你所到之处，我要使那里的百姓慌乱，使你的一切仇敌见你而逃。

text_en: And I will send the pestilence in front of you, which shall drive out the Hivites, the Canaanites, and the Hittites from before you.
text_cn: 我要在你前打发黄蜂，将希威人、客纳罕人和赫特人，由你面前赶走。

text_en: I will not drive them out from before you in one year, or the land would become desolate and the wild animals would multiply against you.
text_cn: 我不在一年之内将他们由你面前赶走，免得田地荒芜，野兽多起来害你。

text_en: Little by little I will drive them out from before you, until you have increased and possess the land.
text_cn: 我要渐渐将他们由你面前赶走，一直到你繁殖增多起来，能占领那地为止。

text_en: I will set your borders from the Red Sea to the sea of the Philistines, and from the wilderness to the Euphrates; for I will hand over to you the inhabitants of the land, and you shall drive them out before you.
text_cn: 我要划定你的国界，由红海直到培肋舍特海，从旷野直到大河；并将那地的居民交在你手中，你要将他们由你面前赶走，

text_en: You shall make no covenant with them and their gods.
text_cn: 决不可与他们和他们的神立约，

text_en: They shall not live in your land, or they will make you sin against me; for if you worship their gods, it will surely be a snare to you.
text_cn: 决不准他们住在你境内，免得引你得罪我，引你事奉他们的神：这为你是一种陷阱。”
